subject: LLMToolchain x Redwood — telemetry stitch & SDK wiring
messages:
From: Nathan Park <nathan@toolchainlabs.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: LLMToolchain x Redwood: telemetry stitch proposal

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well — I’m Nathan, head of integrations at ToolChain Labs. We’ve been building a lightweight SDK & tracer we call TraceWire that instruments LangChain / LlamaIndex chains and emits structured spans and prompt-level metadata. A few customers asked for a tighter experience when routing inference to hosted runtimes, and we think Redwood’s routing + model catalog would be a great partner surface.

Quick ask: would you be open to a 30–45m scoping call next week to sketch a minimal "stitch" so TraceWire can: 1) surface per-request model/version used in Redwood; 2) correlate tokens and cost-level metrics; 3) optionally attach Redwood trace ids for cross-system observability? We have a short partner pitch deck attached (toolchain_partner_pitch.pdf) and a short technical appendix showing the tracer hook points.

Suggested outcome: a mutual action plan (MAP) with a tech spike, an integration beta customer, and a joint public facing doc. If it helps, I can propose times — our engineering lead is available Wed/Thu mornings (PDT).

Attachments: toolchain_partner_pitch.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Thanks,
Nathan Park
Head of Integrations, ToolChain Labs
N: +1 415 555 1212
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Hi Nathan — thanks for reaching out and for the deck. This sounds aligned with a few initiatives we’re prioritizing around observability and partner traceability. I’d like to include Vanessa (product, runtime) and Marissa (ISV partnerships) on the call so we can cover product constraints and GTM.

I’m available:
- Wed Oct 21, 10:00–11:00 PDT
- Thu Oct 22, 09:00–10:00 PDT

Can you send a calendar invite for one of those slots? Also can you paste a one-page technical spec in the invite or Drive link (how TraceWire proposes to surface model/version and token-level metadata)? That will help Vanessa scope the runtime spike quickly.

We’ll aim for the MAP you suggested — we typically run a 2-week spike followed by a 4-week beta with one pilot customer. If there are IP or connector license concerns up front flag them now and I’ll loop legal.

Best,
Kimberly Park

I sent a calendar invite and dropped the technical appendix into a shared drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_drive_link (Docs: tracewire-integration-spec.md, example-span-schema.json).

A couple quick clarifications inline:

On Tue, Oct 20, 2026 at 9:03 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’d like to include Vanessa (product, runtime) and Marissa (ISV partnerships) on the call so we can cover product constraints and GTM.

Absolutely — we’ll have:
- Aisha Kim, Lead Integrations Engineer (trace hooks + SDK)
- Lucas, our runtime instrumentation engineer (will join for tech Qs)
- Myself for partner scope and MAP discussion

One thing to flag: TraceWire can emit optional per-token sampling (low overhead) or full prompt spans. For the initial spike we suggest sampling + model metadata only (model name, checksum, sequence length, token_count) so we avoid high volume exports. If that works for Redwood we can scope the spike to ~3 days of work on our side and a single-day runtime spike on yours.

Calendly (if you want to pick another time): https://calendly.com/nathan-toolchain/30min

Attachment references: tracewire-integration-spec.md (Google Doc), example-span-schema.json (JSON)

—Nathan
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: LLMToolchain x Redwood: telemetry stitch proposal — post-call next steps

Folks — quick internal summary after Wed’s call with ToolChain (Aisha/Lucas + Nathan): we have a clear, minimal path to get TraceWire emitting Redwood trace ids and model metadata with low sampling. Outcomes and actions below.

On Thu, Oct 20, 2026 at 9:35 AM Nathan Park <nathan@toolchainlabs.io> wrote:
> One thing to flag: TraceWire can emit optional per-token sampling (low overhead) or full prompt spans. For the initial spike we suggest sampling + model metadata only (model name, checksum, sequence length, token_count) so we avoid high volume exports.

Summary & proposed MAP:
- Scope: initial tech spike to wire TraceWire -> Redwood runtime so TraceWire spans include: redwood_trace_id, model_id, model_version, token_count, prompt_shard_id (if present). Sampling by default at 1% token-level; option to increase for pilot.
- Owners: Redwood runtime spike (Vanessa + infra eng) 1 day to add header passthrough & trace id correlation; ToolChain spike (Aisha + Lucas) 3 days to add Redwood model metadata exporter and sampler.
- Pilot: one beta customer (TBD) for 4 weeks post spike.
- Legal & commercial: Marissa to surface connector license / MSA questions; suggest a simple addendum for SDK telemetry (no data retention beyond trace id + model metadata).
- Timeline: spike week of Oct 26, pilot onboard Nov 9 if spike goes green.
- Next sync: internal tech kickoff Friday Oct 23 10:30 PDT (Vanessa to run); partner kickoff Oct 26 9:00 PDT.

Attachments: redwood_toolchain_multipoint_map.xlsx (internal MAP draft)

Please confirm owners and I’ll file a brief MAP in HubSpot (HS-1234567890) and loop Legal. Also flag any compliance concerns — ToolChain is open to running in a VPC flow if a customer requires private routing, but initial beta will use hosted API.

Thanks — Kim
